# Attunement

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Spells and Magic](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Attunement)*

Some magic items require a creature to form a bond—called Attunement—with them before the creature can use an item's magical properties. A creature can have Attunement with no more than three magic items at a time. *See also* "Equipment" ("[Magic Items](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/equipment#Attunement)").
